mapper.sql: a.APP_NO AS APP_NO, a.PNO AS PNO, p.TITLE AS POLICY_TITLE, a.USER_ID AS USER_ID, u.NAME AS USER_NAME, a.STATUS AS STATUS, a.APPLY_DATE AS APPLY_DATE, a.UPDATE_DATE AS UPDATE_DATE, a.REASON AS REASON
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPLICATION (PNO, USER_ID, REASON, STATUS, APPLY_DATE) VALUES (#{pno}, #{userId}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, #{applyDate})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM APPLICATION a, POLICY p, USERS u WHERE a.PNO = p.PNO AND a.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND a.APP_NO = #{appNo}

SELECT FROM APPLICATION a, POLICY p, USERS u WHERE a.PNO = p.PNO AND a.USER_ID = u.USER_ID AND a.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY a.APPLY_DATE DESC OFFSET #{pageRequestDTO.skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageRequestDTO.size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT FROM APPLICATION a, POLICY p, USERS u
a.PNO = p.PNO AND a.USER_ID = u.USER_ID
AND ( a.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND a.APPLY_DATE >= #{from}
AND a.APPLY_DATE < #{to} + 1
ORDER BY a.APPLY_DATE DESC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPLICATION a, POLICY p, USERS u
a.PNO = p.PNO AND a.USER_ID = u.USER_ID
AND ( a.USER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
AND a.APPLY_DATE >= #{from}
AND a.APPLY_DATE < #{to} + 1
mapper.update: UPDATE APPLICATION SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE APP_NO = #{appNo}
